title: "Meet Our Team"

## 🇩🇪 The Berlin Bite Crew  
At Berlin Bite Döner, our team is the heart of everything we do.  
All three of our staff members come directly from **Berlin**, bringing with them not only expertise,  
but real stories from the Döner shops and street-food culture that shaped their lives.

Each of them carries a piece of Berlin — and together, they bring that true, unmistakable flavor to Vancouver.

---

## 👨‍🍳 **1. Mehmet “Memo” Yilmaz — Head of Döner Operations**

### **Role:** Master of the Meat Spit & Sauce Specialist  
Memo grew up in Berlin-Kreuzberg, just a few blocks from some of the most iconic Döner places in the city.  
His uncle owned a small, well-loved Döner shop, where Memo began helping out at age 12 — slicing meat,  
prepping vegetables, and learning the secret of the perfect bread-to-filling ratio.

He later worked in several Berlin street-food kitchens before moving to Canada.  
What drives him today?

> *“When someone takes the first bite and says: ‘This tastes like home.’ — That’s why I’m here.”*

Memo is responsible for:
- seasoning and marinating the meats  
- perfecting the sauces (especially our Kräuter sauce)  
- ensuring every Döner is assembled the Berlin way  

---

## 👩‍🍳 **2. Hanna Schneider — Bread & Prep Specialist**

### **Role:** Fresh Bread, Fresh Veggies, Fresh Berlin Energy  
Hanna comes from Berlin-Neukölln, where she worked in a family-owned bakery known for its soft-yet-crispy flatbreads.  
She has always believed that a Döner is only as good as its bread — a philosophy she brings with her to Vancouver.

Before joining Berlin Bite Döner, she spent five years working in a traditional Berlin Backstube,  
learning techniques that give our bread its signature Berlin-style texture.

Her story:

> *“In Canada, I missed the sound of fresh flatbread puffing up in the oven. Now I get to bring that sound back.”*

Hanna is in charge of:
- baking our daily bread and Dürüm wraps  
- preparing vegetables in the authentic Döner-shop style  
- maintaining freshness standards that reflect Berlin quality  

---

## 👨‍🍳 **3. Lukas “Luki” Hartmann — Customer Experience & Fry Master**

### **Role:** Front-of-House Legend & Chief Pommes Engineer  
Born in Berlin-Friedrichshain, Lukas worked for years at a late-night Döner-Imbiss well-known among clubgoers.  
There he learned two important truths:  
1. Pommes must always be hot and crispy.  
2. A warm welcome is just as important as a warm meal.

His laid-back Berlin humor and friendly energy help give Berlin Bite its signature vibe.  
Lukas moved to Vancouver to explore a new life — but brought Berlin’s heart with him.

> *“People come in hungry and leave happy — Döner makes life better, simple as that.”*

Lukas specializes in:
- serving customers with true Berlin charm  
- crafting perfectly crispy Pommes  
- managing the late-night rush with a smile  

---

## ❤️ Together, We Bring Berlin to Vancouver

Our team believes in keeping things simple, honest, and delicious — just like the best Döner shops back home.  
We don’t just make food. We share a culture.
